citations.line: Of the ledger ended for him there. His name was Nanak.
Said Nanak. God's. And when the call to prayer came round
Of Nanak are the witness: the city in its blood,
Who had sacked the cities Nanak wept for, came to the throne
Nanak said there is no Hindu and no Muslim, and left a kitchen
His son Gobind made the Khalsa. Nanak's clearing of the ground
